meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: Claude 会把你在 NanoClaw fork 里做过的定制提取成一份可重放的迁移指南,再在干净的上游代码上重新套用这些定制来完成升级,不走 git merge,因此没有需要合并的冲突。
howto.when: 当你要把自定制过的 NanoClaw fork 升级到上游新版本时触发;若已存在迁移指南,它会先问你是直接跳到升级、更新指南还是重新提取。

say.text: 帮我看看我的 fork 改了哪些地方
say.note: 先提取定制,生成迁移指南

say.text: 把我的定制重新套到最新上游上
say.note: 先在 worktree 里验证,再改动正式安装

say.text: 我已有迁移指南,直接开始升级

howto.what_en: Claude extracts your customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a replayable migration guide, then upgrades by reapplying them on a clean upstream checkout instead of git merge, so there are no merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Runs when you want to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to newer upstream. If a guide already exists, Claude first asks whether to skip to upgrade, update the guide, or re-extract.

say_en.text: Show me what I changed in my fork
say_en.note: Extracts customizations and builds the guide

say_en.text: Reapply my customizations on the latest upstream
say_en.note: Validates in a worktree before touching the live install

say_en.text: I already have a guide, go straight to upgrade
